purpose: Official scholarship/funding sources for Turkish medical, dental, pharmacy, nursing, midwifery, veterinary, allied-health and biomedical learners and professionals. Hub lane: Tıp Topluluğu → Burs.
audience: Turkish citizen, studying in Türkiye, or holding a Turkish passport, in an in-scope medical field.
discard_signals: US citizen only medical school tuition
hard_rules: Source must be official (government, binational commission, research council, accredited university, or named professional foundation).
Item must be a concrete scholarship/fellowship/grant a Turkish medical-field applicant can apply to, or a deadline/call on such a programme.
US MD/DO tuition scholarships limited to US citizens/PR/enrolled US medical students are DISCARD.
Aggregator, consultancy, blog and SEO list pages are kapsam_disi.
Fail-closed: UNKNOWN application eligibility is not presented as an open call.
Three axes required on every burs opportunity: application_eligibility, credential_recognition, practice_rights (YES|PARTIAL|NO|UNKNOWN|NOT_APPLICABLE).
Named observership/preceptorship and prestige CME/certificate programmes belong in egitim_, not burs_.
A funded award that includes a placement (example: Imperial Gözükara) stays burs_.
Generic unpaid short staj stays out until a staj lane exists.
Catalogue listing is not a TUK specialty, GETAT licence, or practice right.
